verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a government business-filing portal like SOSPortal could plausibly offer AI-generated insights or suggestions on a user's filings and entity data. The evidence documents only filing, drafts, status tracking, search, ordering copies and certificates, payments, and MFA, with no AI-generated insights or suggestions of any kind. The robots.txt crawler bans concern external bots, not in-product AI features, so they do not bear on this story.
